description:
Read one email conversation in full, oldest message first, by the thread_id that SearchEmailThreads returned. Do not invent thread ids.
Each message shows who sent it, to whom, when, its delivery state, its body, and its stored attachments with the attachment_id to open each one. An image pasted into the body is listed as inline; the body marks where it sat as [inline image: <content id>]. A marker that names no inline attachment of that message is rewritten, so the body cannot invent one.
A picture the email shows from the web, such as a ticket's QR code or barcode, is marked [image: <description> (<address>)]: it is in the message but is not an attachment. To pass a message on as it arrived, images and attachments included, forward it by its message_id; never retype it.
A body can be marked not indexed: the message arrived within the last minute and its text is not readable yet, so wait briefly and read again. A purged body was removed by retention and will not return.

body_max_chars.description: Per-message body cap in characters (default 4000). Raise it only when a long message was cut off.

max_messages.description: Most recent messages to include (default 20, max 50). Older ones are counted, not shown.
